firefly-upload-replace-choice: Replace Cashew data with server data
firefly-upload-summary: Review what Cashew will send to Firefly III. Keep this Firefly account dedicated to the upload until it finishes.
firefly-upload-resume-summary: Review the original upload. Cashew will recover items it already sent before continuing.
firefly-upload-abandon-warning: Any items already created will stay on Firefly III. Your Cashew data stays on this device. Stop this upload?
firefly-upload-in-progress: This Cashew database has an unfinished first upload. Resume or abandon it before enabling sync.
firefly-upload-rounding: Firefly uses currency precision. Cashew will round {count} transaction rows for this upload.
firefly-upload-skip-loan: Lent and borrowed records stay in Cashew
firefly-upload-skip-linked: This transfer or split includes an excluded transaction
firefly-upload-skip-cash: This cash wallet has no Firefly sync mapping
firefly-upload-skip-budget: This Cashew budget uses filters that Firefly cannot reproduce
firefly-upload-skip-recurrence: This recurrence needs to be set up in Firefly
firefly-upload-skip-attachment: This attachment does not belong to a transaction in the upload
firefly-upload-ready: The upload is complete. Resume it to enable Firefly sync.
firefly-upload-unverified: Cashew could not verify the server response or finish this step.
firefly-upload-mode-active: Turn off Firefly sync before starting an upload.
firefly-upload-source-linked: This Cashew database already has Firefly ID mappings.
firefly-upload-source-changed: Cashew data has changed since the upload was prepared. Review it again. If the upload already began, restore the original data or abandon the upload.
firefly-upload-destination-changed: Reconnect to the original Firefly server and user to resume this upload.
firefly-upload-nonempty: Firefly has existing data in this collection. Cashew stopped the upload.
firefly-upload-missing-receipt: An item from this upload is missing on Firefly. Cashew stopped the upload.
firefly-upload-duplicate: Multiple Firefly items match this record. Resolve the duplicate on Firefly before continuing.
firefly-upload-item-unmapped: Cashew could not upload and verify this item. Check its data and dependencies.
firefly-upload-balance-mismatch: The Firefly balance differs from Cashew for this wallet.
firefly-upload-unresolved: Cashew could not confirm whether Firefly created this item.
firefly-upload-link: It exists on the server, link it
firefly-upload-link-mismatch: The selected Firefly item could not be verified as a match.
firefly-upload-no-matching-object: No matching Firefly item was found. Check again when the server is available.
firefly-upload-resend-warning: The first request may still succeed. Sending it again could create a duplicate. Continue?
firefly-upload-cleanup-warning: This item uploaded successfully, but Cashew could not remove its upload marker from Firefly.
